correctness.rationale: Conditioning on Poisson inter-reset lengths L_j makes X_t a centered Gaussian with conditional variance (2D/3)S_t for S_t=sum L_j^3; therefore excess kurtosis equals 3 Var(S_t)/(ES_t)^2>0. First-renewal convolution yields the stated Laplace transforms and exact f(z),g(z) moments, which imply universal dependence on z=rt. Independently differentiated g/(4f²)-3, reconstructed H(z), verified all zero coefficients n<=8 and positive n=9..15/negative n=16,17; for n>=18 its exact coefficient formula has negative 2^n(1440-84n) minus strictly positive falling-factorial terms. Hence H(z)/z^15 strictly decreases from +infinity to -infinity and has exactly one positive zero: global unimodality is an analytic theorem, not grid inference. Numeric solve corroborated z*=6.65959932539352, K*=3.45618143555349. Small and large z endpoint laws are consistent with exact moment asymptotics.
